How to import these files into onX

Import each folder below into onX's Web Map (webmap.onxmaps.com), one at a time.
In onX, choose Import and add all of that folder's files together.
Tick "Import map data to a new folder".
onX names the new folder with a date and time stamp.
Rename it to the name shown for that folder below.
Importing needs onX Premium or Elite.

01_1_Course_GPX_Dark_Divide_100_Miler/    rename to: 1 - Course GPX Dark Divide 100 Miler
    1_Course_GPX_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Tracks.gpx
        Lines
            2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run

02_2_Aid_Stations_Dark_Divide_100_Miler/    rename to: 2 - Aid Stations Dark Divide 100 Miler
    2_Aid_Stations_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Waypoints.gpx
        Waypoints
            01 - Cispus Learning Center Start/Finish
            02 - Juniper Ridge AS (Used Twice)
                (onX keeps only the first 512 bytes of this note, about 512 characters)
            03 - Sunrise AS (Used Twice)
            04 - Dark Creek AS
            05 - Wilderness Crossing AS
            06 - Wright Meadow AS
            07 - Lewis River AS
            08 - Quartz Butte AS
            09 - Summit Prairie AS

03_3_Course_Segments_Dark_Divide_100_Miler/    rename to: 3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler
    3_Course_Segments_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Tracks.gpx
        Lines
            01 - Cispus Learning Center (START) to Juniper Ridge AS
            02 - Juniper Ridge AS #1 to Sunrise Peak AS
            03 - Sunrise Peak AS #1 to Dark Creek AS
            04 - Dark Creek AS to Wilderness Crossing AS
            05 - Wilderness Crossing AS to Wright Meadow AS
            06 - Wright Meadow AS to Lewis River AS
            07 - Lewis River AS to Quartz Butte AS
            08 - Quartz Butte AS to Summit Prairie AS
            09 - Summit Prairie AS to Sunrise Peak #2 AS
            10 - Sunrise Peak #2 AS to Juniper Ridge #2 AS
            11 - Juniper Ridge #2 AS to Cispus Learning Center (FINISH)
